🏢 MI HB 6264 — Data Centers Face New Energy Rules in Michigan

Michigan is setting a goal for data centers: by 2040, they must use 100% clean or renewable energy. Data centers are defined as facilities housing data center equipment, and ‘clean energy’ is defined as per a 2008 Michigan law. Owners or operators will need to get approval from the Michigan Public Service Commission for how they meet this requirement – through on-site generation, power purchase agreements, or other approved energy instruments. ...
